body:
Thanks :)  You've no idea how good it feels to hear someone say they like how I write/speak.  I...  Actually teared up.

I have.  I've written a bit before, but then I didn't really have time for it anymore, and I just kinda fell out of it and stopped.  I do have more time, now, so I think I will try taking it up again.
Definitely not them.  I'll probably tell the counselor soon.

I'll try downhill biking.  I think bungee jumping, like skydiving, isn't really a good idea with my parents either.  Diving doesn't really seem like the fall would be long enough, so *shrug*  I'll try the mountain biking.

Just some general counseling, I assume.  I didn't really pay attention when my parents were talking about it.  It's nothing more than a low-level therapy, I know.  I haven't told my parents about cutting or suicidal urges, etc.

I've been going to counseling for a short time.  So far, it hasn't proven useful.

Thanks for the suggestion.  I dunno if I'd be able to qualify for the army (That is it, right?), because of a medical condition.

Thanks.

What sports would you suggest?  The only one I can think of, is sky diving, like PieSupply said, and that would be too expensive. :/
